criteria.evidence: The ambiguity is real: §§3.3, 4.4 and 4.8 do not specify MCX list-entry widths, while §16.2 admits NAME entries but excludes indexed list entries. The diff decides expansion, scalar target, duplicate rejection, empty controls and k.

The resulting operation is the exact conjunction-controlled X required by §4.4. The witness map (p,q,c) → (q XOR [c=3],p,c) and reverse-order adjoint agree with §5.3. Expansion also supplies the complete operands required by K78.

Flattened control count and order supply §§8.1–8.3 cost and scheme operands. The actual catalog’s gate.mcx recipe takes a width-K controls formal followed by a width-one target; no recipe modification is needed.

§9.2 hashes canonical source text, so retaining the written operand preserves identity under the authorized same-version route. Both reported object/closure hash pairs and the ref@0.9 envelope hash were independently reproduced. The note correctly requires schedule regeneration and certificate rechecking.

criteria.evidence: The change preserves controlled-anything and linear wire semantics without narrowing any North Star capability. The mixed-fat-object section keeps expansion and certificates within device closures and names the remaining shared boundary obligations.

The amendment is localized and implementable. It distinguishes source syntax, resolved operands, primitive matching and catalog realization, and accurately separates the older first-bit checker result from current scalar-only rejection.

suggestions: In §15’s conformance additions, publish the concrete mixed-list vector given under C6. Also state: “mcx (b, s) t resolves to [b[0],b[1],s,t]; it has the same unitary and K78 primitive identity as mcx (s, b) t, while retaining its distinct canonical source bytes.” This tests operand ordering independently of conjunction semantics.
path_to_accept: No blocking changes are needed. Accept through the explicitly council-authorized 0.9 K-repair route, retaining the stated consumer revalidation requirements. Publishing the mixed-list operand/arity vector would raise C6 from 4 to 5.
